statement: Full Rosati-fixed degree-g real multiplication implies delta(A)=1 in characteristic zero; for any such order every prime divisor of delta divides its index in the full integer ring
depends_on: C.4j; Appell-Humbert; MilneCM2020 Prop6.1 and Prop1.39/Cor1.40; C.4n; C.4p
notes: Actual Jacobian-product summands for g2 with odd order index and g3 with order index prime to6; includes simple CM endomorphism orders locally maximal at these primes and their good reductions. Generic End=Z and nonmaximal obstruction primes remain.
